$comment: Machine-readable MVP implementation sequence for Code Governance. Documentation-only; no packages are created by this audit.
prerequisites_before_enforcement: durable hash-chained audit backend for the decision kernel
ACP GitHub-domain adapter + durable one-time clearance reference

phases.name: Product contracts and workflow skeleton
contracts_added: PRODUCT_INTERNAL: FrozenTaskEnvelope, PatchCandidate, ValidationEvidenceBundle, ExactChangeAuthorization envelope, workflow state machine
phases.acceptance: state machine + reference propagation unit-tested; no GitHub I/O
phases.rollback: delete product package; no neutral change

phases.name: GitHub evidence ingestion (shadow)
contracts_added: PRODUCT: PR/commit/check evidence records, claim manifest schema
phases.acceptance: webhook signature verification; installation auth; immutable evidence refs; shadow operation

phases.name: TAP and decision integration (shadow/recommendation)
phases.acceptance: claim manifest -> TAP -> DecisionRecord mapping in shadow; then recommendation check-run

phases.name: Exact-action mapping (no execution)
contracts_added: PRODUCT_INTERNAL: merge identity tuple, ExactChangeAuthorization envelope
phases.acceptance: merge identity bound; CER + ActionGate authorize; no dispatch

phases.name: ACP live clearance (shadow first)
phases.acceptance: pre-merge signals; expiry; stale-artifact rejection in shadow

phases.name: GitHub Execution Provider (controlled enforcement)
contracts_added: PROVIDER_SPECIFIC: GitHub execution adapter (model on actiongate_provider)
phases.authority_impact: dispatch role only; no policy interpretation
phases.acceptance: one exact merge op; idempotency; observation; reconciliation; governance-chain proof (§4.7) fail-closed

phases.name: Merge queue
phases.acceptance: merge-group SHA re-validation + derived authorization + ACP clearance of exact merge-group

phases.name: Competitive Code Adjudication (optional)
phases.acceptance: advisory recommendation only; §9.2 integrity controls; linked to DecisionRecord

phases.name: Deployment Governance
phases.acceptance: separate artifact + environment authorization chain; build provenance/digest binding
